dct_description_sm: This repository contains a collection of resources generated throughout the course of completing the SSHRC funded research project: "Collaborative Water Services Between First Nations and Municipalities in Ontario". It includes project outputs, such as peer reviewed publications, posters, presentations, and other knowledge products. The SSHRC grant application submitted by the research team and the Notice of Award document (with grant reviewer comments) are also included.
